strings.59-ФЗ статья 11 Три письма — ни одного о: 59-FZ Article 11 Three letters, not one substantive response
strings.59-ФЗ, статья 12, часть 1: рассмотрение: Federal Law No. 59-FZ, Article 12, part 1: reviewing a submission within the scope of competence.
strings.Авторское учебное изложение закона: Author's training summary of the law
strings.В варианте без новых доводов прежние отв: In the no-new-arguments variant, earlier responses genuinely address the issue; here they are only notices, so the letter count does not provide the same grounds.
strings.В данном упражнении счёт начинается со с: In this exercise, counting starts on the day after registration; a deadline falling on a non-working day moves to the next working day. This is a separate task about the deadline for the specified action, not about fully resolving the real-life problem.
strings.В учебном комплекте присутствуют только: The training package contains only a registration notice, referral and interim status. There are no substantive replies. Article 11, part 5 does not permit counting outgoing letters instead of checking these conditions.
strings.В чьей компетенции находится вопрос сейч: Whose remit does the issue fall within now?
strings.В этой смене вы готовите проект решения: In this shift, you prepare a draft decision for the authorized head and organizational steps for the specified body. You do not order inspections or penalties on behalf of another agency. No real messages are sent.
strings.Выясните, что именно произошло и что под: Establish exactly what happened and what the materials confirm.
strings.Граждане и все материалы инцидента вымыш: The citizens and all incident materials are fictional. Any conditions of a particular service given here are a training model, not a quotation from real regulations. Act within your role. The calendar task concerns only the action it specifies.
strings.Для этого основания нужны неоднократные: This ground requires repeated written substantive responses and the other established conditions, not an arbitrary number of notices.
strings.Завершить дело: теперь исходящих писем ч: Close the case: there are now four outgoing letters.
strings.Заявитель обязан представить новый факт,: The applicant must provide a new fact, otherwise any letter is deleted.
strings.Заявитель повторяет тот же вопрос и прос: The applicant repeats the same question and requests an answer. The calendar exercise calculates the deadline for the newly registered appeal. This does not erase obligations or possible missed deadlines on the earlier material.
strings.Каких ответов нет в подборке?: What kind of responses are absent from the collection?
strings.Каких ответов нет в подборке? Свяжите из: What kind of responses are absent from the collection? Link the extracted information to the decision based on the materials.
strings.Какой вывод подтверждается сопоставление: Which conclusion is supported by comparing the materials?
strings.Количество сообщений не равно количеству: The number of messages is not the number of substantive responses.
The current authority’s competence is established.
strings.Крайний день рассмотрения обращения: Last day for reviewing the submission
strings.Любые три письма равнозначны ответам по: Any three letters are equivalent to substantive responses.
strings.Материал передали по компетенции, выводо: The material was referred to the competent authority; there are no conclusions about the problem.
strings.Мне говорят, что на мой вопрос уже трижд: They say my question has been answered three times. But the first letter only gives an incoming number, the second says where it was forwarded, and the third says it is still under review. Where is the answer to the actual question?
strings.Найдите применимое положение, проверьте: Find the applicable provision, check its connection to the materials and justify the action. Training material is not a normative legal act.
strings.Найдите статью о порядке рассмотрения от: Find the article on handling specific types of appeals and match the relevant part to the case circumstances.
strings.Начать новый срок так, будто предыдущего: Start a new period as though the earlier unfinished appeal never existed
strings.Наш орган получил материал и уполномочен: Our authority received the material and is authorised to consider the issue. It need not be sent to another recipient again.
strings.Не заменяет специальную норму: Does not replace a special provision
strings.Обвинить заявителя в повторности, не чит: Accuse the applicant of repetition without reading the draft.
strings.Обращение рассматривается в пределах ком: An appeal is considered within jurisdiction; any special procedure requires a separate check. General written-reply periods are not the same as deadlines for repairs, benefits or register corrections.
strings.Объяснить заявителю, какие вопросы будут: Explain which issues will be considered without requiring the applicant to invent new arguments
strings.Отправлено {{sent}}, поступило {{receive: Sent on {{sent}}, received on {{received}}, registered on {{registered}}. The latest event in the materials is dated {{observed}}. Do not confuse the complaint deadline with the service deadline or the time needed to resolve the problem.
strings.Первый фрагмент пересказывает условие за: The first passage restates the task conditions, not real regulations or a website extract. The external link verifies the legal basis, not the incident's facts.
strings.Переадресация не заменяет ответ по сущес: Referral does not replace a substantive response.
strings.Повторно переадресовать вопрос, хотя ком: Refer the issue again although our authority’s competence is established.
strings.Подготовить надлежащее рассмотрение и оц: Prepare proper consideration and assessment of the unfinished earlier case
strings.Подготовить прекращение переписки, сосла: Prepare to end correspondence based solely on the outgoing-letter count.
strings.Подготовить рассмотрение вопроса компете: Prepare consideration by the competent authority and check the earlier appeal’s status without declaring notices to be substantive responses.
strings.Помощник: «В части 5 статьи 11 важно чис: Assistant: “Part 5 of Article 11 is about the number of letters, not their contents.”
strings.Последующий результат проверен по сущест: The subsequent result has been checked against the substance of the case.
strings.Предыдущие уведомления не подтверждают н: Earlier notices do not establish repeated written substantive responses; grounds for ending correspondence on this basis have not been established.
strings.Прекращение работы без выяснения обстоят: Stopping work without clarifying the circumstances
strings.Проверить отсутствие ответа на поставлен: Verify the absence of an answer to the question and return the draft for substantive consideration within the relevant remit.
strings.Проверить полноту последующего ответа и: Check completeness of the next response and the status of the original obligations
strings.Продолжить надлежащее рассмотрение: усло: Continue proper consideration: the condition of repeated written substantive responses is not confirmed.

Continue proper review: the condition of repeated written responses on the merits has not been confirmed. In the variant without new arguments, the previous responses genuinely address the substance of the issue; here, they are only notices, so the number of letters does not provide the same grounds.
strings.Промежуточный статус без оценки обстояте: An interim status without assessment of the circumstances.
strings.Профиль исчисления этого упражнения: исх: This exercise's calculation profile excludes the starting day and rolls the deadline forward, using the federal five-day working week. It is not a rule for every procedure.
strings.Процедура предоставления услуги вместо о: A service-delivery procedure instead of reviewing a submission
strings.Рассмотрение обращения по закону № 59-ФЗ: Review of a submission under Law No. 59-FZ
strings.Регистрация не является решением вопроса: Registration is not resolution of the issue.
strings.Сведения о другом заявителе, объекте или: Information about another applicant, facility or period does not replace verification in this case. A body's name does not grant an employee unlimited powers.
strings.Сначала определите действие, для которог: First identify the action to which the deadline applies. Applying for a service, registering a complaint and resolving a problem are not the same event.
strings.Сопоставить содержание всех прежних сооб: Compare the contents of all earlier messages
strings.Сопоставьте вывод с документами и провер: Compare the conclusion with the documents and check the limits of authority.
strings.Существенное обстоятельство продолжения: A material circumstance in the continuation was left unchecked.
strings.Считать уведомление о регистрации оконча: Treat a registration notice as the final substantive response
strings.Только обстоятельства данной вымышленной: Only the circumstances of this fictional situation
strings.Три исходящих номера автоматически дают: Three outgoing reference numbers automatically entitle the authority to end correspondence.
strings.Три письма — ни одного ответа по существ: Three letters, no substantive reply · checking the basis
strings.Установить, был ли вопрос рассмотрен по: Establish whether the issue was considered substantively
strings.Участник вымышленной учебной ситуации: Participant in a fictional training situation
strings.Учебная подборка содержит подтверждение: The training collection contains registration confirmation, a referral notice and a current-status message. None addresses the substantive question. The current authority is competent; no decision on the issue has been made.
strings.Учебное продолжение. Исполнитель подгото: Training follow-up. The case officer prepared a response, but it again gives only the registration number and the date of transfer to their department.
strings.Учебный материал; ссылка ведёт к правово: Training material; the link leads to the legal basis
strings.Что есть в третьем?: What is in the third letter?
strings.Что содержится в первом письме?: What is in the first letter?
strings.Что сообщено во втором?: What does the second letter say?
strings.по существу поставленного вопроса: on the substance of the issue raised
